theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_chart_blowup_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → 0 < c → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ u ∈ B, ∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ v in B, f (blowUpMap (ψ u) r (ψ v)) * (fderiv ℝ ψ v).toLinearMap.normDet) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 ((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap.normDet * ∫ y, f (fderiv ℝ ψ u y)))
